Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets

Class Badge

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets.Badge
@BeanType(properties="count,dot,max,tone,label") public class Badge extends Object
An overlay badge on a header action (a bell count, for example) or a BarBadge.

A badge is exactly one of a count badge (count) or a dot badge (dot); it never carries both. The optional max clamps a large count to "<max>+" and tone selects the badge colour from the shared StatusTone palette. A count is painted with textContent — never innerHTML.

The tone is serialized as its enum name (e.g. "WARNING"); the client lowercases it into the data-juneau-badge-tone attribute. Colours map as:

  • StatusTone.INFO — blue
  • StatusTone.SUCCESS — green
  • StatusTone.WARNING — amber
  • StatusTone.ERROR — red
  • StatusTone.NEUTRAL — neutral
Example:

// A red unread-count badge that caps at "99+". Badge badge = Badge.count(120).tone(StatusTone.ERROR).max(99).label("unread notifications"); badge.validate();

Since:
10.0.0
